people.name: Beth-zur
people.line: Town in Judah, fortified by Rehoboam, repaired by Nehemiah.

people.name: Maon
people.line: Son of Shammai, a descendant of Caleb.

people.name: Shammai
people.line: Father of Maon, ancestor of Caleb

translations.web: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
translations.bsb: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
translations.kjv: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Bethzur.
translations.asv: And the son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
